title: Fix Krea2 upscaler: refiner pass after UltimateSDUpscale + tier-gated accelerator LoRA
description: FIX, not an enhancement - the Krea2 upscale op was unusable on raw (non-turbo) and only passable on turbo: heavy noise at cfg 2. Reauthored the raw template: UltimateSDUpscale now feeds a VAEEncode -> ClownsharKSampler_Beta refiner -> VAEDecode chain before Output_image, and the SD-upscale model is chosen by a new MpiIfElse 'is high tier' driven off the existing Input_Tier (MpiMath 'a == 1'), so turbo-off runs the base model with no accelerator LoRA. The refiner itself always runs on the accelerator-LoRA model (2 steps) by design - a cheap distilled polish pass in both tiers. Injection needed no change (title-keyed, surface 16 -> 16), but the refiner exposed a real progress defect: phaseProgress' tile mode was one-way, so the post-tile bar was swallowed and the status bar refilled 0-100 percent a second time while still reading the last tile. Fixed in js/services/phaseProgress.js; guarded by tests/tile-post-pass-stage.test.cjs. Detail in brief.md.
